name: Corporate Governance & Board Oversight
description: SAMA Corporate Governance Regulations, Board Risk & Audit Committees, Fit & Proper criteria, conflicts of interest.

name: AML/CFT Governance & Sanctions
description: Saudi Anti-Money Laundering Law, SAFIU reporting, UNSC & Presidency of State Security (PSS) lists, freezing.

name: Customer Due Diligence (CDD) & KYC
description: Identification of natural persons and legal entities, Nafath/Absher verification, 5% Beneficial Ownership threshold.

name: Digital Onboarding & E-KYC
description: Remote customer onboarding, biometric liveness validation, non-face-to-face risk mitigation, Nafath API.

name: Transaction Monitoring & Suspicious Reporting
description: Automated alert generation, threshold monitoring, STR/CTR filing with SAFIU, structured transactions.

name: Customer Risk Categorisation & PEPs
description: Politically Exposed Persons (domestic and international), high-risk jurisdictions, Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD).

name: Cyber Security Framework (CSF) & Governance
description: SAMA CSF v3.0, CISO independence, cyber risk strategy, Board IT Steering Committee, Maturity Level 3+.

name: Threat Intelligence & SOC Operations
description: 24/7 Security Operations Center, SAMA Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) feed integration, 2-hour incident reporting.

name: Threat-Led Penetration Testing (TLPT)
description: SAMA Red Teaming / TLPT framework, simulated cyber-attacks, 30-day mandatory remediation of critical findings.

name: Cloud Computing & Data Sovereignty
description: SAMA Cloud Computing Regulatory Framework, In-Kingdom data residency, cloud tenant isolation, Class 1-4 data.

name: Outsourcing & Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)
description: SAMA Outsourcing Rules, material outsourcing SAMA non-objection, vendor exit strategies and audit clauses.

name: Business Continuity & Operational Resilience
description: SAMA BCM Framework, Disaster Recovery site in KSA, RTO/RPO limits, annual unannounced failover simulations.

name: Open Banking & Financial APIs
description: SAMA Open Banking Framework, AISP and PISP API specifications, OAuth2 security, Open Banking Portal onboarding.

name: Payment Systems & National Rails
description: SARIE real-time gross settlement, mada debit scheme, Sadad bill presentment, instant payment limit controls.

name: Consumer Protection & Fair Treatment
description: SAMA Consumer Protection Principles, Financial Consumer Rights Charter, transparent tariff disclosure, 10-day complaint SLA.

name: Responsible Lending & APR Transparency
description: Debt Burden Ratio (DBR) caps (33.33% salary / 45% mortgage), Total Cost of Credit, APR schedule disclosure.

name: Credit Risk Policy & Appraisal
description: Credit underwriting guidelines, internal rating validation, delegation of credit authority, early warning indicators.

name: Large Exposures & Concentration Ceilings
description: Single borrower limits (15% of regulatory capital), related parties (25%), sector and geographic concentration.

name: SIMAH Credit Bureau Reporting & Inquiries
description: Mandatory credit history pull and monthly reporting to Saudi Credit Bureau (SIMAH), 30-day default updates.

name: Capital Adequacy & Basel III Accord
description: CET1, Tier 1, Total Capital ratios, Capital Conservation Buffer (2.5%), D-SIB capital surcharges.

name: Liquidity Risk & Basel Ratios (LCR / NSFR)
description: Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR >= 100%), Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR >= 100%), intraday liquidity stress testing.

name: ICAAP & Enterprise Stress Testing
description: Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process, macroeconomic stress scenarios, supervisory capital buffers.

name: Internal Audit & Assurance (3rd Line)
description: Risk-Based Internal Audit (RBIA), Board Audit Committee independence, compliance verification audit cycles.

name: Financial Fraud Prevention & Countermeasures
description: Real-time fraud screening, mule account ring detection, SIM-swap validation, SAMA fraud reporting portal.

name: Sharia Governance & Islamic Banking Compliance
description: Sharia Supervisory Board approvals, Murabaha/Ijara/Sukuk structuring compliance, annual Sharia audit.
